en.headline: First Northern Metropolis Marathon starts with about 15000 runners
en.dek: The full marathon began at 6:30am from the Heung Yee Kuk building in Sha Tin, with routes including the Lung Shan Tunnel and a first-time finish on Fanling Bypass.
body: The inaugural Northern Metropolis Marathon organised by the Heung Yee Kuk began this morning, drawing about 15,000 participants across full marathon, half marathon, 10-kilometre and 1,600-metre events.

The full marathon started at 6:30am at the Heung Yee Kuk building in Shek Mun, Sha Tin, with Home and Youth Affairs Secretary Alice Mak and Heung Yee Kuk chairman Kenneth Lau among those firing the starting gun. The course passes through Sha Tin, Tai Po’s Yuen Chau Tsai and Lam Tsuen River areas, the Lung Shan Tunnel, and finishes for the first time on the Fanling Bypass.

Runners said the higher temperature and humidity today made conditions more challenging. Some planned to adjust their pace rather than chase personal bests, while others looked forward to experiencing the new sections of the Northern Metropolis, including the Lung Shan Tunnel.

Temporary road closures began in stages from 2am in affected areas, and MTR services on the East Rail Line between Hung Hom and Sheung Shui, and on the Tuen Ma Line between Tai Wai and Wu Kai Sha, started earlier from 4:20am to support participants and spectators.

zh.headline: 首屆北部都會區馬拉松今早開跑 約1.5萬人參與
zh.dek: 全馬賽事早上6時半在沙田石門新界鄉議局大樓起步，途經龍山隧道，並以首次開放的粉嶺繞道作終點。
body: 新界鄉議局主辦的首屆北部都會區馬拉松今早舉行，設全馬、半馬、10公里及1600米賽事，約1.5萬人報名參與。
全馬挑戰組早上6時半在沙田石門新界鄉議局大樓起步，民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟及鄉議局主席劉業強等出席鳴槍。賽道途經沙田、大埔元洲仔及林村河、龍山隧道，最後於首次開放予跑步賽事使用的粉嶺繞道衝線。半馬則由科學園跑至粉嶺繞道。
有跑手指今日氣溫及濕度較高，會調整節奏，不會追求打破個人最佳成績；亦有人期待體驗北都新路段及龍山隧道。
有關區域由凌晨2時起分階段實施臨時封路及交通改道。港鐵東鐵綫紅磡至上水及屯馬綫大圍至烏溪沙段頭班車提早至凌晨4時20分開出，方便參賽者及觀眾。
